claims.claim: School-wide method availability is distinct from actor learning. UnLockGong inserts a shared method name and enables Practice for the first method; it does not call actor LearnEsotericaEx.

Teacher command needs a valid reachable learner with interruptible work and sufficient learner TreeExp. Learning checks method eligibility, disciple work, hidden teaching restriction, rank, incompatibilities and prerequisites. Teaching has a 20-second idle toil after movement; learner comprehension multiplier is0.75, or0.5 for that actor's current MasterID. Completion rechecks gates/stock and then actually subtracts TreeExp through LearnEsotericaEx, adds DaoHang and records learned method.

Completed learning changes actual actor combat skills, recipes, magic/modifiers and selected world access, depending on the definition. DanFang_1's non-commented definition declares eight medicine recipes; EsotericaFinish iterates Dans into LearnDanFormulas. No automatic granted items or mastered craft are shown by this unlock.

Working grounded shelves add100 institutional memory capacity each. Inserting a new method consumes difficulty units of capacity, rejects duplicates/insufficient space and gives the contributing actor comprehension. Deposit toil costs min(difficulty*100/(intelligence*logicStage),600) simulation seconds for a selected manual; it records institutional access without deleting the manual in the inspected deposit path. Interruption publishes failure and removes its item command, while JobCangJingGe puts down the carried item.

Archive self-study has20 simulation seconds, rank/eligibility gates and learner comprehension debit at0.75 of derived cost. Insufficient comprehension at settlement publishes failure with no LearnEsotericaEx. Archive scale also lowers GetTreeExpNeed by min(floor(usedMemory/1000)*0.01,0.2). UI eligibility flag itself can remain true when comprehension is insufficient; command and settlement stock gates establish actual rejection.

World travel launches an occupied hidden actor, with outbound/visit/return stages. Base journey duration is distance*3 divided by flight-speed and event modifiers. GetLingCost is literally0 for departure; normal visit waits120 simulation seconds and dispatches actual story options. Arrival count drives child-location discovery through sys_openplace then Lua helper and PlacesMgr unlock, while the first linked visit can expose linked locations.

Stay mode generates repeated stories and returns after16800 simulation seconds in the inspected path. Callback during outward travel maps elapsed outward progress into return-stage progress; no refund of elapsed time is shown. Non-God CheckWaitDie return preparation drains10–30percent of MaxLing; return releases exploration/equipment flags and actual carried awards. Punishment and fight-map waits delay progression; shortage/no selected story never implies a guaranteed reward.

prerequisites: A valid current method definition and eligible learner; rank/prerequisite/mutex checks remain actor-local.
Archive use requires a reachable shelf/workspace, actual manual or learned contributing actor, free difficulty capacity.
World departure requires an applicable exploration command, connected room and no cant-explore flag; caller-level UI admission not comprehensively audited.
decisions: Teach a named learner, use archive self-study, or contribute a method to institutional storage.
Choose destination, ordinary visit versus stay, story option at arrival or callback.
expenditures: Learning spends learner TreeExp, using0.75 general or0.5 actual mentor teaching multiplier; not teacher TreeExp in inspected branch.
Archive deposit occupies actor/workspace for computed time and difficulty capacity; no copied book item minted/deleted by this deposit path.
Outbound GetLingCost=0; time/actor availability spent; non-God return CheckWaitDie debits10–30percent MaxLing.
state_changes: Shared GongList, archive allesolist/esodic/used capacity stay separate from actor EsotericaV/TreeExp/DaoHang.
Actor learning updates real skill/recipe/modifier/access consumers; discovery updates ArrivedCount and unlocked place data.
Travel retains a stages/callback/actual award path and returns the same actor.
downstream_consumers: EsotericaFinish consumes the chosen learned definition into actor recipes/skills/modifiers and selected world access.
PlacesMgr.IsLocked/UnLockPlace and actual story selection consume repeated discovery evidence.
time_policy: All inspected toils/managers use passed dt/keeptime and game-time state. Travel and stay policies differ. No universal offline catch-up claim; runtime display seconds are not asserted to wall-clock seconds.
failure_and_aftermath: Teaching interrupted or invalid/insufficient learner at finish: no learning debit/output, movement/occupied time already spent; whole job-engine interruption mechanics reviewed by actors lane.
Archive duplicates/capacity loss: no new insert/comprehension award, reported failure; item returns through existing job put-down path.
Self-study shortfall at finish: failure message, no method awarded.
Callback preserves elapsed journey rather than teleporting home; travel punishment pauses progression, and some arrivals have no eligible story.
uncertainties: No guarantee of random story item yield, specific recipe balance, stable public localization name or universal offline policy.
